# Junior Software Engineer, Store Platform — Chicago, IL, full-time

Responsibilities: build services and web features used by store associates; write tests; review code with senior engineers.
Required: Python or JavaScript; REST APIs; Git; automated testing.
Preferred: exposure to computer vision; web accessibility.
